road_sense.bs_enable_desc: Shows a merged rear + side camera view in a floating window when you turn on the indicator. Size and position are set below. Left signal shows rear + left; right signal shows right + rear.
road_sense.bs_merge_desc: Merge the rear and side cameras into one view, or show just one camera. Single-camera views fill the window with that camera's full field of view; the Blend point and Blend softness sliders only apply to the merged view.
road_sense.bs_rotation_desc: Rotate the single-camera view on screen. Useful when a side camera reads better turned upright. The window reshapes to match the rotation.
road_sense.bs_rotation_left_desc: Rotate the left-turn (left camera) view on screen. Useful when the left camera reads better turned upright. The window reshapes to match.
road_sense.bs_rotation_right_desc: Rotate the right-turn (right camera) view on screen. The right camera is mirror-imaged from the left, so it often needs a different angle. The window reshapes to match.
road_sense.bs_auto_base_desc: The angle used while driving forward. Reverse gear flips the view 180° so it reads naturally when backing up.
road_sense.bs_rectify_desc: Straighten the fisheye/barrel curve of the single-camera side and rear views. Higher values flatten the bulge but crop the edges slightly. Only applies to the single-camera views, not the merged one.
road_sense.bs_display_desc: Where the blind-spot view appears. Driver cluster shows it on the gauge screen behind the wheel; while a turn signal is active it temporarily replaces the gauges, which return when you stop signalling.
road_sense.bs_cluster_layout_desc: Match this to your instrument cluster size. If the projected view looks stretched or cropped, try another option.
road_sense.bs_calib_desc: Tap a side to open a live preview window on the car's screen, then drag the sliders below to align it. The preview sits on top of this page — tap Hide preview if it covers the controls, or move it with the Position settings above and press Apply Changes. Apply when it looks right.
road_sense.bs_needs_overlay: Allow "display over other apps" to show the blind-spot view
road_sense.master_enable_desc: Detects road hazards (bumps, potholes, speed breakers) from motion and GPS, and warns you ahead of known ones. All other RoadSense settings only take effect while this is on.
road_sense.map_open_desc: Open the full-screen map to search routes, navigate, and see road hazards along the way. Tap any hazard to confirm it or remove it.
road_sense.map_open_hint: Open from the in-car app to launch the map.
road_sense.routing_help: The map basemap is free. Turn-by-turn routing needs a free personal key from a Valhalla provider — paste yours here. It is optional: the map and hazards work without it. Your key is stored encrypted on-device.
road_sense.routing_guide_title: How to get a free routing key
road_sense.routing_step1: Tap "Get a free key" to open the Stadia Maps signup, then create a free account (no credit card for the free tier).
road_sense.routing_step2: In the dashboard, open Properties and create a Property, then go to Authentication and API Keys.
road_sense.routing_step3: Click "Create API key" and copy the key string it shows you.
road_sense.routing_step4: Paste it into the "Routing API key" field below and tap Save. Leave the endpoint as the default.
road_sense.routing_endpoint_desc: The Valhalla-compatible routing URL. Leave as the default unless your provider gives you a different one.
road_sense.routing_key_desc: Your personal BYOK key. Stored encrypted on-device and never shown again after saving.
road_sense.routing_key_set_ph: A key is saved — paste a new one to replace it
road_sense.map_cluster_project_desc: Shows the full map on the driver cluster behind the wheel, replacing the gauges while active. The blind-spot camera still appears on top automatically when you turn on a signal.
road_sense.map_cluster_auto_desc: Start projecting the map to the cluster automatically each time the car powers on.
road_sense.map_cluster_auto_conflict_body: The Projection screen is set to auto-cast an app to the driver cluster on startup. The cluster can only show one thing at a time. Turn that off and auto-project the map instead?
road_sense.map_cluster_layout_desc: Match this to your instrument cluster. Shared with the blind-spot cluster view. If the projection looks stretched or cropped, try another option.
road_sense.calibration_enable_desc: Shows each detected hazard on the screen overlay with confirm / correct buttons so you can teach RoadSense which detections are real. Use this for a few drives to tune detection for your vehicle, then turn it off.
road_sense.overlay_show_desc: Shows the floating RoadSense pill and hazard card on the screen. Turn this off to hide it — detection, audio warnings, and crowdsourcing keep running in the background; only the on-screen display is hidden.
road_sense.detect_sensitivity_desc: How easily RoadSense flags a bump, pothole or speed breaker. 50% is the default tuning. Slide toward More to catch gentler features (and a few more false detections); slide toward Less to only flag clear, hard hits. This changes what gets detected — not the same as the warning Minimum Confidence below.
road_sense.warn_enable_desc: Alert you as you approach a hazard RoadSense already knows about on your route.
road_sense.warn_mode_desc: How the warning is delivered when a hazard is ahead.
road_sense.warn_channel_desc: Which audio channel the warning chime plays on. Navigation uses the car's guidance channel, so the chime ducks your music instead of competing with it and follows the navigation volume.
road_sense.warn_test_desc: Plays the loudest warning chime now on the channel above, so you can check the selected maximum. The real warning only sounds while driving towards a hazard RoadSense already knows about.
road_sense.warn_test_playing: Chime sent at the selected RoadSense volume
road_sense.warn_lead_desc: How many seconds before the hazard the warning fires. Higher gives more reaction time; lower fires closer to the hazard.
road_sense.warn_conf_desc: Only warn about hazards RoadSense is at least this sure of. 0 warns about everything it knows; higher values suppress low-confidence hazards.
road_sense.warn_severity_desc: Choose which hazard severities trigger a warning. Disable minor ones if you only want alerts for the worst hazards.
road_sense.crowd_note: By default RoadSense keeps everything on this device. Upload and download are separate — turning one on does not turn on the other.
road_sense.crowd_upload_desc: Sends anonymized hazard detections off-device to improve the shared map. Off by default — RoadSense is on-device-only until you enable this.
road_sense.crowd_download_desc: Pulls hazards reported by other drivers so you get warned about hazards you haven't driven over yet. Off by default.
road_sense.crowd_worker_url_desc: Optional. Point upload/download at your own sync worker instead of the default endpoint.
road_sense.delete_local_desc: Removes the hazard detections and calibrations stored on this device. Cannot be undone.
road_sense.delete_cloud_desc: Removes the detections you uploaded from the shared cloud map. Other drivers' data is unaffected. Cannot be undone.
road_sense.confirm_delete_local: Delete all RoadSense calibrations stored on this device? This cannot be undone.
road_sense.confirm_delete_cloud: Delete the RoadSense detections you uploaded from the shared cloud map? This cannot be undone.
road_sense.bs_reverse_desc: Keep the blind-spot view hidden while reverse gear is engaged, so it doesn't cover the reversing camera.
road_sense.bs_speed_range_desc: Only show the blind-spot view while driving within this speed range. Leave both at 0 (Any) to show it at any speed. Useful to keep the view out of the way in slow traffic or at motorway speeds.
road_sense.warn_volume_desc: Sets the loudest RoadSense warning level. Minor and moderate chimes stay gentler than severe warnings.
road_sense.bs_speed_any: Any speed — the view always appears on the indicator.
road_sense.bs_speed_err_order: The maximum must not be lower than the minimum.
road_sense.bs_speed_err_range: Enter a whole number between 0 and {max} km/h (0 = any).
road_sense.bs_speed_max_aria: Maximum speed in km/h, 0 for any
road_sense.bs_speed_min_aria: Minimum speed in km/h, 0 for any
road_sense.bs_speed_not_loaded: Could not read the saved speed range — reload the page before changing it.

notif.origin_banner: Push notifications require Zrok or a reverse proxy. Cloudflare quick tunnels change every restart and would invalidate every subscription. Tailscale serves over plain HTTP and can't be used for Web Push unless using a reverse proxy. Open the dashboard from your reserved Zrok or reverse proxy URL on your phone, Add to Home Screen, then return here to enable.
notif.backend_banner: Notifications backend not initialized. Reserve a Zrok URL via the daemons screen and restart the daemon to enable push delivery.
notif.push_delivery_sub: Enables alerts on the device you are currently using. Each phone you install the dashboard onto needs to be enabled here once.
notif.categories_sub: Toggle which kinds of alerts are pushed to this device. Each category fires when the head unit detects the matching event; what triggers it depends on the related daemon's settings.
notif.devices_sub: Every phone that enabled push notifications appears here. Use Remove to deregister a device. Disable on this device above also unsubscribes the current browser locally, while Remove is server-side only.
notif.perm_zrok_required: Push delivery requires Zrok or a reverse proxy — see banner above.
notif.perm_unsupported: Notifications not supported in this browser
notif.perm_unsupported_install: Notifications not supported. If using Safari, try adding to home screen to get notifications
notif.perm_granted: Notifications are enabled on this device
notif.perm_denied: Notifications are blocked. Enable in browser settings.
notif.enable_first: Enable notifications on this device first.
notif.remove_device_tombstoned: Removed. Notifications won't return on this device for 30 minutes — re-enable from this page if you change your mind.
notif.pwa_not_loaded: PWA bootstrap not loaded — install to home screen first.
notif.enable_success: Push notifications enabled on this device.
notif.subscribe_browser_error: Your browser refused the push subscription: {error}. Try a different browser — Samsung Internet without Google Play Services, Brave with shields enabled, and Edge during outages are all known to fail here.
notif.tunnel_unreachable: Can't reach the head unit. The Zrok or reverse-proxy URL stopped resolving — check the tunnel is up and reload the page.
notif.sev_critical: Critical: drop-everything alert — sticky banner, longer vibrate, ignores quiet hours.
notif.sev_warn: Warn: short vibrate, standard banner — something to look at soon.
notif.sev_auto: Auto: severity is decided per-event from the data (slow leak → warn, fast leak → critical).
notif.sev_info: Info: silent banner, no vibrate — reserved for confirmations.
notif.min_importance_sub: A device-wide floor applied on top of the categories above. Raise it to silence lower-importance pushes in one place — e.g. "Warn and up" drops every Notice/Info push (routine surveillance, charging started/stopped) while keeping Alerts and Criticals. Off tiers are still recorded in the log.
notif.telegram_sub: Send surveillance events to a paired Telegram chat. Pair the bot in the Telegram daemon settings; toggles below decide which severities reach the chat. Off tiers are still recorded — only the message is suppressed.
notif.telegram_delivery_sub: What kind of events Telegram receives. Independent from the per-tier filter above — these toggle entire categories on or off.
notif.vehicle_layout_sub: Pick which side of the car the driver sits on. This decides whether door notifications label the front-axis doors as Front-left or Front-right. Saves immediately and applies to the next door event without restarting the daemon.
notif.drive_lhd_sub: Driver sits on the left (most of Europe, North America, China).
notif.drive_rhd_sub: Driver sits on the right (UK, Australia, India, Japan).
notif.tyre_limits_sub: Set the normal pressure range for each axle. A tyre below the minimum or above the maximum raises a warning; below the critical value it raises a deflated-tyre alert. Used for push and Telegram notifications and for the corner colours in Vehicle Control. Defaults suit stock tyres — change them if your placard pressures differ.
notif.tyre_critical_note: At or below this, the alert is escalated to critical. Applies to all four tyres and cannot exceed either axle minimum.
notif.tyre_reset_hint: Defaults restored — press Save to apply.
notif.tyre_load_failed: Could not load saved limits — showing defaults.
notif.tyre_err_range: Enter a whole number between {min} and {max} kPa.
notif.tyre_err_order: The maximum must be higher than the minimum.
notif.tyre_err_critical: The critical value must not exceed either axle minimum.
notif.tyre_unit_note: How pressure readings are shown across the dashboard and in alerts. Limits below are always set in kPa.

charge.title: Charging
charge.subtitle: Monitor your charging sessions and energy usage
charge.quality_warning_short: Contradictory power and charging energy hidden.
charge.quality_info_open: Why was this charging data excluded?
charge.quality_info_body:
OverDrive identified an explicit AC session whose stored peak power is at least 25 kW, which contradicts that connection type and matches a known legacy telemetry fault. The original session, samples, cost and totals remain unchanged. OverDrive only hides that session's charging energy, average power and peak power from the affected displays so the invalid readings are not presented as evidence.

The LFP calibration candidate badge is separate: it requires a completed 10% or lower to 99% or higher SOC span and an LFP battery declared by the configured physical vehicle model. It does not make the hidden power readings valid.
charge.estimated_explanation: OverDrive labels a value as estimated when the vehicle does not provide a direct reading. Estimated power is calculated from battery data; estimated energy and cost use battery/SOC changes and the configured tariff. Peak power is shown only from real power samples.
charge.chart_energy_sub: kWh added each session — DC blue, AC teal
charge.range_pick: Pick a start or end date
charge.range_order: Start date must be before end date
charge.delete_confirm: Delete this charging session? This cannot be undone.
charge.edit_cost_prompt: Enter the total cost of this charge. Leave empty to reset it.

charge.settings_clear_desc: Permanently delete all recorded charging sessions and curves
charge.settings_clear_confirm: Delete all charging history? This cannot be undone.

charge.disabled_hint: Enable charging analytics in Settings to start recording
charge.no_sessions_hint: Sessions appear automatically when you plug in to charge
charge.tariffs_desc: Save a rate for a place — charges there are priced with it automatically. The rates above apply everywhere else.
charge.tariffs_empty_hint: Add one where you usually charge and every charge there gets priced automatically
charge.tariff_dc_rate_hint: Leave empty when this place bills DC at the same rate
charge.tariff_radius_hint: How close a charge must be to use this tariff
charge.tariff_confirm_delete: Delete this tariff? Charges priced with it will fall back to your other rates.
charge.tariff_err_no_rate: Enter an AC or DC rate
charge.tariff_err_no_gps: No GPS fix yet — a tariff needs a location to match against
charge.tariff_err_radius: Match radius must be between 25 and 2000 m
charge.tariff_err_dupe_label: A tariff with that label already exists
charge.tariff_auto_hint: Saved. Charges within {radius} m of here will use this tariff automatically.

tier_desc.excellent: Outstanding driving habits. You maximize regen, maintain smooth pedal inputs, and keep consistent speeds.
tier_desc.good: Solid driving with room to grow. Occasional hard braking or speed fluctuations bring the score down.
tier_desc.average: Moderate efficiency. Frequent speed changes or inconsistent pedal use are costing you range.
tier_desc.poor: Aggressive patterns detected. Heavy acceleration and late braking are significantly reducing your range.

trip.drive_more_for_tips: 💡 Drive more trips to get personalized improvement suggestions.

anticipation.label: Anticipation
anticipation.desc: How well you read traffic ahead and lift off the accelerator early before braking.
anticipation.tip: Coast more before red lights. Lift off the pedal 3–5 seconds earlier than usual.

smoothness.label: Smoothness
smoothness.desc: How gradually you apply and release the accelerator and brake pedals.
smoothness.tip: Pretend there's a glass of water on the dashboard. Smooth transitions keep it steady.

speed_discipline.label: Speed Discipline
speed_discipline.desc: How consistently you maintain appropriate speeds without frequent speeding.
speed_discipline.tip: Use cruise control on highways. Staying within {limit} of the limit saves energy.

efficiency.label: Efficiency
efficiency.desc: Your energy consumption per km compared to the optimal baseline for your vehicle, route terrain, and conditions.
efficiency.tip: Pre-condition the cabin while plugged in. Scores adjust for terrain — hills won't penalize you unfairly.

consistency.label: Consistency
consistency.desc: How uniform your driving style is throughout the trip. Erratic behavior lowers this.
consistency.tip: Pick a driving style and stick with it. Consistent habits build muscle memory.

trip.no_trips_hint: Enable trip analytics and start driving to see your trips here

card.score_tooltip: Your overall driving efficiency score based on 5 criteria: anticipation, smoothness, speed discipline, efficiency, and consistency.
card.score_tip: 💡 Focus on your weakest category to see the biggest improvement.

settings.title: Trip Analytics
settings.auto_record: Automatically record trips and compute driving scores
settings.rate_help: Cost per kWh for trip cost calculation
settings.tank_capacity_help: Fuel tank size — needed to compute litres burned from BYD's % reading
settings.fuel_price_help: Price per litre (or gallon) for petrol cost calculation
settings.distance_unit_desc: Display distances and speeds in km or miles
settings.storage_location_desc: Choose where to save trip telemetry
settings.rate_source_note: Trips are costed at the rate of your last charge at a saved tariff location. This rate applies until then.
settings.rate_from_charge: Trips are costed at your last charge: {rate}/kWh.
settings.rate_from_charge_named: Trips are costed at your last charge: {rate}/kWh ({label}).

recover.title: Recover Missing Trips
recover.desc: If trips vanished from your history after an SD card was briefly undetected, this rebuilds them from the telemetry files still on disk. Distance, speed, route and elevation are restored; energy, cost and driving scores aren’t available for recovered trips. Safe to run anytime.
recover.timeout: Recovery is taking too long. Check the Trips tab shortly.

recovered.badge_title: Recovered from telemetry — no driving score available
recovered.detail_note: Recovered from telemetry. Distance, speed and elevation are reconstructed from GPS; battery, energy, cost and driving scores were not recorded for this trip.

scores.anticipation_text: Measures how well you read traffic ahead and lift off the accelerator early before braking. Higher scores mean less energy wasted on sudden stops.
scores.anticipation_tip: 💡 Tip: Coast more before red lights and slow traffic. Lift off the pedal 3–5 seconds earlier than usual.
scores.smoothness_text: Tracks how gradually you apply and release the accelerator and brake pedals. Jerky inputs waste energy and reduce comfort.
scores.smoothness_tip: 💡 Tip: Pretend there's a glass of water on the dashboard. Smooth pedal transitions keep it from spilling.
scores.speed_disc_text: Evaluates how consistently you maintain appropriate speeds. Frequent speeding and large speed variations reduce this score.
scores.speed_disc_tip: 💡 Tip: Use cruise control on highways. Keeping within 5 km/h of the limit saves significant energy.
scores.efficiency_text: Compares your energy consumption per km against the optimal baseline for your vehicle, route, and conditions.
scores.efficiency_tip: 💡 Tip: Pre-condition the cabin while plugged in. Avoid full-throttle launches from stops.
scores.consistency_text: Measures how uniform your driving style is throughout the trip. Erratic behavior (alternating aggressive and calm) lowers this score.
scores.consistency_tip: 💡 Tip: Pick a driving style and stick with it. Consistent habits build muscle memory for efficiency.

automation.invalid_form: Please check the form has been correctly filled.
automation.clip_window_invalid: Clip duration must total between 1 and 60 seconds (seconds before + after).
automation.variables_help_intro: A variable is a named flag the app remembers. One automation sets it; another reads it. The name is a label you choose (e.g. Parking_Mode) and must match exactly wherever you use it — it's case-sensitive. The value is free text: true/false for a flag, or a word like sport for a mode.
automation.variables_help_unset: A variable you've never set reads as empty, so "not equal to true" is true until you set it.
automation.variables_help_mutex: To stop a routine re-triggering while it runs: add a condition Parking_Mode ≠ true, then make the first action Set Parking_Mode = true. Reset it to false in the automation that ends the routine.
automation.operating_mode_help_intro: This controls the entire OverDrive daemon stack, not just Surveillance.
automation.operating_mode_help_on_only: On Only: after ACC turns off, due ACC-off automation actions finish, then all OverDrive daemons shut down until ACC turns on.
automation.operating_mode_help_on_and_off: On + Off: OverDrive stays running after ACC-off so parked Surveillance and background monitoring can continue. This uses more parked battery.
automation.set_drive_mode_description: Switch the drive mode (ECO / Sport / Normal / Snow).
automation.set_powertrain_mode_description: Switch between EV and HEV on fuel-capable hybrid vehicles.
automation.run_shell_description: Run a shell command in the daemon when this automation fires. Autonomous — requires the separate automation-shell permission (off by default).
automation.allow_shell_desc: Let automations run a raw shell command automatically when their conditions match. This runs unattended in the background — leave off unless you are certain what your automations do.
automation.safety_warning: These guards apply to matching vehicle actions started through OverDrive's Automations, Action Groups, Key Mapping, Quick Controls, MQTT, Vehicle Controls, and saved seat positions. Turning one off lets OverDrive attempt that action while the car is moving or its state is unknown. Advanced raw shell, CAN, and diagnostic actions are outside these guards.
automation.safety_unavailable: Safety settings are unavailable. The current guard state could not be verified; reload this page to try again.
automation.safety_disable_confirm: Disable this safety guard? The action will be allowed while the car is moving or its state is unknown.
automation.safety_door_locks_desc: Block locking or unlocking the doors unless the car is safely parked.
automation.safety_trunk_desc: Block opening or closing the tailgate. Stop remains available.
automation.safety_mirror_fold_desc: Block folding the exterior mirrors. Unfolding remains available.
automation.safety_positioning_desc: Block seat-memory recall and saved-position movement. The vehicle may still require Park itself.
automation.safety_headlight_off_desc: Block selecting headlight Off. Auto, parking lights and low beam remain available.
automation.safety_display_brightness_desc: Block changes to infotainment, driver-cluster and HUD brightness.
automation.safety_display_power_desc: Block screen power changes and turning the HUD off. Turning the HUD on remains available.
automation.safety_screen_media_desc: Block full-screen playback. Speaker-only audio remains available.
automation.shell_warning: Runs unattended as the daemon whenever this automation fires. A bad command can disrupt the head unit. Requires the automation-shell permission.
automation.confirm_delete_body: This automation will be permanently deleted. This can’t be undone.
automation.audio_library_desc: Upload MP3, WAV or MP4 sounds (max 16 MB). The Play Audio action and key mapping can play any sound here.
automation.audio_delete_confirm: Delete this sound? Automations that use it will stop playing it.
automation.audio_upload_replaced: Replaced an existing sound with the same name
automation.backup_desc: Save all your automations to a file, or restore them from a backup. Importing merges into your current automations (existing ones with the same id are replaced).
automation.backup_import_invalid: That file isn't a valid automations backup
automation.zone_hint: Matches a Safe Location zone name, or "none" when the car is outside every zone. Pick a zone or create one below.
automation.zone_err_name: Enter a name for the zone.
automation.zone_err_coords: Enter a valid latitude (-90..90) and longitude (-180..180).
automation.zone_err_radius: Radius must be between 15 and 5000 metres.

automation.wireless_charging_right_description: Turn the right wireless charging pad on or off. (Only on cars with two pads.)

recording.mode_proximity_desc: Record when objects approach the vehicle
recording.recording_quality_desc: Higher tiers preserve more detail at the cost of more storage. Output is a 2560×1920 mosaic of four 1280×960 cameras.
recording.rectify_desc: Straightens the residual fisheye barrel curve in recordings and surveillance clips. 0 = off (raw HAL output). Higher values pull peripheral pixels inward.
recording.clip_duration_desc: Length of each recorded video segment. Applies to both driving (ACC on) and parked surveillance (ACC off) recordings, on the next segment rotation.
recording.clip_duration_warning: Longer clips mean fewer, larger files — but an in-progress clip is only finalized when it rotates. On sudden power loss (e.g. battery cut on impact) the current clip can be lost, so a 10-minute setting risks up to 10 minutes of unsaved footage vs 2. Keep 2 min if your vehicle can lose power abruptly.
recording.select_mode_desc: Choose when to record while driving
recording.storage_fallback_internal: SD/USB unavailable — saving to internal storage
recording.storage_fallback_enforcing: SD/USB unavailable — saving to internal storage, keeping the latest {mb} MB
recording.telemetry_show_desc: Overlay vehicle data on ACC-on trip / manual recordings
recording.audio_desc: Captures the cabin microphone alongside video. Active only during ACC-on recording (Continuous, Drive, Proximity Guard); never during Surveillance.
recording.audio_update_failed: Failed to update audio recording setting
recording.geocoding_enabled_name: Tag dashcam recordings with place names
recording.geocoding_enabled_desc: Reverse-geocode the recording-start GPS into a district/city label and save it next to each clip's sidecar. Off by default.
recording.geocoding_online_desc: Falls back to OpenStreetMap Nominatim when on-device geocoding cannot name a location. Sends only the recording-start coordinates and your device language.
recording.geocoding_custom_url_desc: Optional. Point to a self-hosted instance to skip the public OSM endpoint entirely. Shared with surveillance.
recording.geocoding_enabled_toast: Place tagging enabled for dashcam recordings
recording.geocoding_disabled_toast: Place tagging disabled for dashcam recordings
recording.layout_desc: Standard records the four 360 cameras as a 2×2 grid. Dashcam puts the forward road view across the top with the 360 left, rear and right cameras along the bottom. Telemetry overlay is preserved either way.
recording.layout_use_windshield_label: Use Windshield Camera in Dashcam Layout
recording.layout_use_windshield_desc: When available, use the dedicated windshield camera for the top dashcam view. Falls back to the 360 front camera if the stream cannot be opened.
recording.layout_windshield_unavailable: No windshield camera is defined for the active camera profile/configuration.
recording.timeline_note: Recording continues if radar triggers again within post-buffer time
recording.telemetry_fields_hint: Choose which items to burn in:
recording.telemetry_fields_desc: Choose what the overlay draws on trip and manual recordings.

Clear BYD Cloud credentials?

Deterrent actions (flash lights, horn) will stop working until you set up again.
surveillance.confirm_disable_all_classes: AI detection turns off entirely: events only trigger on raw motion, and new recordings are rate-limited to one per 30 seconds. Real events may be missed.
surveillance.enable_desc: Monitor cameras for motion and object detection
surveillance.accoff_mode_desc: Smart records motion-triggered events. Continuous records the whole time the car is parked, with no filters and no AI.
surveillance.accoff_hint_smart: Motion + AI gating. Recordings begin only when something moves and AI confirms a person, vehicle, or other relevant object.
surveillance.accoff_hint_continuous: Plain rolling recording. All four cameras record from arm to disarm with no motion filters and no AI. Uses much more storage.
surveillance.arm_mode_desc: When surveillance arms after the car powers off. Both modes honor safe locations and schedules.
surveillance.arm_hint_lock: Arms when you lock the doors and disarms when you unlock (so it won't record you). If your car can't report lock status, it arms 60 seconds after power-off as a fallback.
surveillance.arm_hint_power: Arms as soon as the car powers off and disarms when it powers back on. Works on every car, but may record you as you leave.
surveillance.operating_mode_desc: Whether Overdrive keeps running after the car is turned off. On Only fully shuts Overdrive down when you park; while-driving features (dashcam, trips, charging) are unaffected.
surveillance.operating_mode_hint_on_off: Overdrive keeps watching while parked — surveillance and background monitoring stay active. Uses a little battery overnight.
surveillance.operating_mode_hint_on_only: Overdrive fully shuts down when you turn the car off — no background activity, no parked surveillance, no battery use. Dashcam, trips and charging still work while you're driving, and everything starts back up automatically the next time you switch the car on.
surveillance.operating_mode_saved_on_only: Shuts down when the car is off
surveillance.operating_mode_postoff_disabled_note: These settings control surveillance after the car is off. In On Only mode Overdrive shuts down when parked, so they don't apply. Switch to On & Off to use them.
surveillance.keep_usb_power_desc: Keeps the USB ports powered after the car is switched off (for example to charge a phone or power an accessory). Turn off to let the head unit sleep and save the 12V battery. Note: the SD-card slot shares the USB power rail, so turning this off also powers down the SD card while parked — surveillance will record to Internal storage instead. Takes effect the next time the car is switched off.
surveillance.mobile_data_keepalive: Keep mobile data awake while parked
surveillance.mobile_data_keepalive_desc: On some models the mobile data module goes to sleep a while after the car is switched off, so the car drops off the network while parked. Turn this on to keep it awake. It is recommended to leave this off unless you actually lose cellular while parked, because keeping the connection alive uses extra battery and mobile data. Only takes effect if mobile data is already on when you park. Takes effect the next time the car is switched off.
surveillance.mobile_data_keepalive_saved_on: Mobile data will stay awake while parked (next ACC-OFF)
surveillance.mobile_data_keepalive_saved_off: Mobile data will be left alone while parked
surveillance.low_power_mode_desc: Saves battery while parked by running the camera at a low frame rate (about 5 fps) when nothing is happening, then instantly ramping back to full quality the moment motion is detected. Motion and object detection are unaffected — the same events are caught — but the recorded footage during quiet periods is choppier to save power. Takes effect while the car is parked and surveillance is armed.
surveillance.low_power_saved_on: Low-power mode on — camera idles at a low frame rate while parked
surveillance.low_power_saved_off: Low-power mode off — camera stays at full frame rate while parked
surveillance.low_soc_cutoff_desc: Stop surveillance and let the car sleep when the main battery drops to this level, protecting it from over-discharge. Set to Off to never stop on battery level.
surveillance.low_soc_cutoff_hint: Higher values protect the battery more but end surveillance sooner. Off keeps watching until the battery is critically low.
surveillance.keep_usb_saved_on: USB will stay powered while parked
surveillance.keep_usb_saved_off: USB will sleep while parked (next ACC-OFF)
surveillance.usb_off_storage_notice: USB power is off, so the SD card is unpowered while parked. Surveillance records to Internal storage until USB power is turned back on.
surveillance.usb_off_confirm_body: The SD card shares the USB power rail, so it will be unpowered while parked. Surveillance will be switched to Internal storage so recording keeps working. You can switch back to the SD card after turning USB power on again.
surveillance.usb_off_confirm_unavailable: Confirmation unavailable — cannot turn off USB power safely
surveillance.usb_off_switched_internal: USB power off — surveillance now records to Internal storage
surveillance.storage_blocked_usb_off: Turn "Keep USB powered" on to use SD/USB while parked
surveillance.safe_desc: Camera won't start when parked here
surveillance.env_desc: Quick preset for your parking situation
surveillance.det_zone_desc: How far from the car motion triggers an alert
surveillance.custom_config: Custom configuration — select a preset to reset to recommended values.

distance.1_hint: Near — only detects large/close objects (cars, groups)
distance.2_hint: Close — good for parking lots, detects people nearby
distance.3_hint: Balanced — detects people up to ~8m away
distance.4_hint: Far — catches distant movement, may include passersby
distance.5_hint: Very Far — maximum range, use in quiet areas

sens.1_hint: Strict — large objects only (car/group), ignores single walkers
sens.2_hint: Conservative — solid objects, good for windy conditions
sens.3_hint: Balanced — triggers on walking people, ignores bugs/leaves
sens.4_hint: Sensitive — catches motion immediately on block entry
sens.5_hint: Aggressive — triggers on any motion, use indoors/garages only

v2_sens_hint.1: Only detects large, close movement like someone touching the car.
v2_sens_hint.2: Detects solid objects nearby. Good for windy conditions.
v2_sens_hint.3: Balanced — detects a person approaching within about 3 meters.
v2_sens_hint.4: Sensitive — catches motion quickly, good for people at distance.
v2_sens_hint.5: Maximum — detects any movement in the camera view. May increase false alerts.

env_hint.outdoor: Standard filtering for open parking lots and driveways. Handles sun, clouds, and headlights.
env_hint.garage: Aggressive light filtering for indoor parking. Ignores fluorescent flicker and reflections.
env_hint.street: Tuned for busy areas with foot traffic. Longer loitering time to ignore passersby.

zone_hint.close: Triggers only on activity close to the car. Roughly the bottom third of each camera's view (typically within ~3m on the rear camera). Cuts most false positives from passing traffic.
zone_hint.normal: Standard detection band. Roughly the bottom two-thirds of each camera's view (typically within ~6m on the rear camera). Default for everyday parking.
zone_hint.extended: No distance gate — uses the entire camera frame. Detects activity at any depth, including across the street. Expect more triggers from passing traffic.

shadow_hint.0: Shadow filtering disabled. May cause false recordings from tree shadows and cloud movement.
shadow_hint.1: Light filtering — catches obvious shadows. Good for garages with fluorescent lights.
shadow_hint.2: Balanced filtering — catches most tree shadows while preserving real motion detection.
shadow_hint.3: Aggressive filtering — maximum shadow rejection. Use when parked under trees with heavy wind.

surveillance.byd_pwd_keep: Leave blank to keep current password
surveillance.byd_pin_keep: Leave blank to keep current PIN
surveillance.byd_pin_hint: The 4–6 digit Pin you set in the official BYD app
surveillance.byd_pwd_pin_required: Password and control PIN are required for first setup
surveillance.byd_request_long: Request is taking long... checking status in a moment
surveillance.byd_test_sent: ✓ Flash command sent — check your car!
surveillance.byd_test_check_car: Command may have been sent — check your car
surveillance.loitering_time_desc: How long someone must stay near the car before recording starts
surveillance.loitering_time_hint: Higher values ignore people just walking past. Lower values are more responsive.
surveillance.approach_trigger_desc: Record sooner when the camera AI confirms a real person or vehicle approaching — without waiting out the full loitering time
surveillance.approach_trigger_hint: Set to Off to require the full loitering time for every event. Lower values record walk-ups faster (only fires when the AI sees a real person/vehicle).
surveillance.shadow_filter_desc: Filters out tree shadows, cloud shadows, and other lighting changes that cause false recordings
surveillance.motion_salience_desc: Trigger on large, close, moving objects even when the AI can't identify them
surveillance.motion_salience_hint: Catches events the AI misses — someone walking right up to the car in poor light, or a large vehicle pulling in close, where object recognition returns nothing. Only fires when the movement is big, close, and travels steadily across the scene for about a second, so wind-blown branches, shadows, rain and headlight sweeps are still ignored. Expect some extra recordings with no identified person or vehicle: these are kept even with "Discard non-actor recordings" on, because a clip the AI couldn't classify is the last one worth deleting automatically.
surveillance.discard_empty_motion_desc: Aggressively drop recordings where no real person or vehicle was tracked
surveillance.discard_empty_motion_hint: Good if you get false alerts from shadows or tree-branch movement — these clips are deleted automatically when nothing real was tracked. Caution: in low light or unclear conditions it can occasionally discard a real threat the AI failed to identify. Leave off if you'd rather keep every recording.
surveillance.discard_empty_motion_night_desc: Extend the filter to dark scenes using motion shape instead of brightness
surveillance.discard_empty_motion_night_hint: By default the filter only runs in daylight, because in the dark the AI can miss a real person entirely. With this on, night clips are discarded only when the motion looks like wind-blown foliage or a lighting change (headlights, reflections) and never translated across the scene like a person would. Higher chance of dropping a real night-time event than the daytime filter — leave off if in doubt.
surveillance.camera_controls_desc: Enable or disable detection per camera
surveillance.camera_controls_hint: Disable cameras facing a wall or busy road to reduce false alerts.
surveillance.sidecam_boost_desc: Override sensitivity and detection zone for the left and right cameras only. Useful when neighbours pull into adjacent stalls and the front/rear settings are too conservative to catch them.
surveillance.detect_objects_desc: AI identifies what triggered the motion
surveillance.detect_objects_hint: Select which objects YOLO AI should identify. Motion detection triggers regardless — AI classifies what was detected.
surveillance.telegram_two_stage_desc: Send a quick "recording started" message, then the photo when it ends. Off by default — the photo alone is usually enough.
surveillance.telegram_tiers_desc: Pick which severity tiers reach your Telegram chat. Off tiers are still recorded; only the message is suppressed.
surveillance.tier_alert_desc: Approaching person, vehicle close enough to warrant attention
surveillance.tier_critical_desc: Person at very close range — likely tampering / loitering
surveillance.motion_heatmap_desc: Overlay motion detection zones on stream
surveillance.motion_heatmap_title: Shows colored blocks on the live stream indicating where motion is detected.
surveillance.filter_debug_log_title: Logs detailed filter decisions for each detection.
surveillance.detection_zones_hint: Limit motion detection to specific areas of each camera. When off, the full camera frame is used for detection.
surveillance.roi_enable_desc: Draw a detection zone for this camera
surveillance.schedule_enable_desc: Only activate surveillance during specific days and hours
surveillance.schedule_hint: Add time windows when surveillance should be active. Outside these windows, surveillance mode won't start even if ACC is off.
surveillance.deterrent_on_motion_desc: Action to take via BYD Cloud when a threat is confirmed. Requires BYD Cloud account setup.
surveillance.deterrent_hint: Flash Lights and Horn + Lights use BYD's cloud API. The command bounces off BYD's servers to the car's T-Box. Requires BYD Cloud account setup below.
surveillance.deterrent_warning: BYD Cloud account not configured. Set up your credentials below to enable cloud deterrents.
surveillance.byd_cloud_hint: Connect your BYD app account to enable remote commands (door lock, flash lights, horn). Only derived key hashes are stored — your raw password is never saved.
surveillance.byd_region_desc: Must match the region your BYD account was registered in. If unsure, try Europe (EU) first — it's the default for most overseas accounts.
surveillance.byd_cloud_merge_desc: SOC, charging, and temperature from BYD cloud — may be more accurate when parked
surveillance.storage_location_desc: Choose where to save surveillance events
surveillance.camera_fps_desc: Shared with recording. Takes effect on next ACC OFF.
surveillance.recording_quality_desc: Quality for parked (ACC-off) surveillance recording — independent of the driving dashcam quality. Higher tiers preserve more detail at the cost of more storage.
surveillance.camera_fps_desc_split: Frame rate for parked (ACC-off) surveillance — independent of the driving dashcam. Lower saves power & storage while parked.
surveillance.telegram_not_paired: Telegram bot isn't paired yet — tier toggles have no effect until you link a bot.
surveillance.deterrent_hint_v2: Flash Lights and Horn + Lights use BYD's cloud API. BYD Cloud account setup required — set it up on the BYD Cloud page (sidebar → Integrations → BYD Cloud).
surveillance.geocoding_enabled_name: Tag sentry events with place names
surveillance.geocoding_enabled_desc: Reverse-geocode the event-start GPS into a district/city label and save it next to each clip's sidecar. Off by default to keep parked-at-home addresses out of shared notifications.
surveillance.geocoding_online_desc: Falls back to OpenStreetMap Nominatim when on-device geocoding cannot name a location. Sends only the event-start coordinates and your device language.
surveillance.geocoding_custom_url_desc: Optional. Point to a self-hosted instance to skip the public OSM endpoint entirely. Shared with dashcam settings.
surveillance.geocoding_enabled_toast: Place tagging enabled for sentry events
surveillance.geocoding_disabled_toast: Place tagging disabled for sentry events
surveillance.screen_deterrent_enable_desc: Wake the head-unit screen and show a fullscreen warning when motion is detected. Works without BYD Cloud.
surveillance.screen_deterrent_duration_desc: How long the warning stays visible after motion stops. While motion continues, the warning stays up.
surveillance.screen_deterrent_message_desc: Replaces "YOU ARE ON CAMERA" on the default red screen.
surveillance.screen_deterrent_content_help: Pick ONE: a custom message overlaid on the default red screen, OR your own image, GIF or MP4 clip. The uploaded asset always wins if both are set.
surveillance.screen_deterrent_override_banner: An asset is set — the custom message is being ignored. Remove the asset to use a message instead.
surveillance.screen_deterrent_image_desc: PNG / JPG / WebP / GIF up to 8 MB, or an MP4 clip up to 10 s, 1080p and 10 MB. Video loops while the warning is visible; audio is not played.
surveillance.screen_deterrent_remove_confirm: Remove the uploaded asset? The deterrent will fall back to the default red screen.
surveillance.screen_deterrent_hint: The screen wakes only while ACC is off. When the car turns on, the deterrent is suppressed.
surveillance.screen_deterrent_remove_body: The deterrent will fall back to the default red screen. This cannot be undone.
surveillance.byd_clear_creds_body: Deterrent actions (flash lights, horn) will stop working until you set up again.
surveillance.oem_record: Also record OEM Dashcam on events
surveillance.oem_record_desc: Captures a synchronized dvr_*.mp4 from the forward sensor alongside the panoramic event clip. Honors the same Safe Locations, Schedule, and per-camera filters as the panoramic surveillance.
surveillance.oem_record_enabled: OEM Dashcam recording on events enabled
surveillance.oem_record_disabled: OEM Dashcam recording on events disabled
surveillance.oem_id_unset_hint: Open Diagnostics → Camera Probe to pick the OEM Dashcam camera id first.
surveillance.telemetry_show_desc: Burn vehicle data into ACC-off surveillance event clips. Separate from the ACC-on recording overlay.
surveillance.telemetry_fields_desc: Choose what the overlay draws on surveillance clips.
surveillance.disabled_deferred: Surveillance turned off — it will not start on the next park
surveillance.enabled_deferred: Surveillance will start when the vehicle is next turned off
surveillance.screen_deterrent_video_too_long: Video too long (max 10 s) — it loops, so keep it short

mqtt.empty_p: No MQTT connections configured. Add a connection to start publishing vehicle telemetry.
mqtt.tailscale_hint: For private brokers on your tailnet: enable Tailscale proxy in the tailscale daemon settings to connect without port forwarding. Note: while enabled, public brokers will not be reachable.
mqtt.adaptive_desc: Publish slower when vehicle is parked
mqtt.retain_desc: Broker keeps last message for new subscribers
mqtt.field_parked_interval_desc: Heartbeat cadence while the car is parked. Off = use the max interval. Higher = fewer publishes, less data.
mqtt.field_charging_interval_desc: Heartbeat cadence while charging. Off = use the max interval. Takes precedence over the parked cadence.
mqtt.change_only_desc: Skip publishing when no values changed (a heartbeat still fires at the max interval)
mqtt.ha_discovery_desc: Auto-create entities in Home Assistant. Publishes per-field retained topics (no aggregate JSON).
mqtt.heartbeat_send_all_desc: Re-send every value at the heartbeat interval even if nothing changed. Recovers state lost to a connection drop.
mqtt.flush_on_state_change_desc: Re-send every value when the car changes mode (engine on/off, charging start/stop), so the new state always reaches HA even if a single update is lost at a network handoff. Light — fires only on transitions.
mqtt.allow_control_desc: Expose controllable entities (climate, windows, seats, settings…) and act on commands from Home Assistant. Local SDK only — never the BYD cloud. Off by default.

abrp.enable_desc: Send live vehicle data to A Better Route Planner
abrp.change_only_desc: Skip uploads when no values changed. A heartbeat still fires at the max interval.
abrp.gate_on_app: Only while ABRP is in use
abrp.gate_on_app_desc: Stream telemetry only while the ABRP app is open on this head unit — zero uploads otherwise.

performance.data_usage_unavailable: Per-app data accounting isn't available on this device's kernel.

backup.section_sub: Save your Overdrive settings to a file, or restore them on this same head unit. The file includes your credentials — keep it private.
backup.export_value: Download a backup file of your current settings.
backup.import_value: Load a backup file made on this head unit.
backup.trips_opt_desc: Adds your trip stats (distance, energy, cost, scores, start/end locations) to the export. Detailed per-trip telemetry is not included. The file will contain your location history — keep it private.
backup.invalid_file: That file is not a valid Overdrive backup.
backup.download_unsupported: Could not start the download on this browser.
backup.restore_sub: This replaces your current Overdrive settings with the ones in this backup. Services will reload. This only works on the same head unit the backup was made on.
backup.restart_hint: Restart the camera daemon (Daemons → Camera → Restart) to make sure every restored setting is applied.

byd_cloud.country_supporting: Use the country your BYD app account was registered under.
byd_cloud.region_derived: Country code {country} uses the {region} BYD server.
byd_cloud.empty_status: Connect on the Account tab to see your VIN and last cloud push here.
byd_cloud.empty_advanced: No advanced actions available until credentials are saved on the Account tab.
byd_cloud.clear_hint: Removes the saved credentials from this device. You'll need to re-enter your BYD app login + PIN to use cloud commands again.
byd_cloud.recommend_title: Use an alternate vehicle authorization profile
byd_cloud.recommend_sub: Recommended — keeps your main BYD account isolated. Tap to view setup steps.
byd_cloud.recommend_step_1: Open the official BYD app on your phone.
byd_cloud.recommend_step_4: Enter a secondary email — it must be different from your main account email.
byd_cloud.recommend_step_5: Choose an authorization period that fits how long you want this profile to stay active.
byd_cloud.recommend_step_6: Log out of the BYD app, then sign up with the secondary email using the verification code and create a password.
byd_cloud.recommend_step_7: Tap Lock or Unlock in the BYD app — it will prompt you to set a Control Pin.
byd_cloud.recommend_step_8: Enter the secondary email, password, and Control Pin here in OverDrive.

telegram.bot_hint: Create a bot via @BotFather on Telegram, copy the token here, and OverDrive will validate it. The token is stored on this device only.
telegram.connect_failed: Could not connect — check token + network
telegram.confirm_clear: Clear the bot token, paired account, and preferences?
telegram.pair_intro: Generate a one-time PIN, then send "/pair <PIN>" to the bot from the Telegram app on your phone. The PIN expires in 10 minutes.
telegram.pair_empty: Set the bot token on the Bot tab first, then come back here to pair your Telegram account.
telegram.pin_expired: PIN expired — generate a new one
telegram.confirm_unpair: Stop sending alerts to this Telegram account?
telegram.video_uploads_desc: Upload short clips on Critical events. Costs more bandwidth — disable if you're on a slow tunnel.
telegram.tiers_pointer: Per-tier severity filter (Notice / Alert / Critical) lives on the Notifications → Telegram tab.
telegram.critical_alerts_desc: Drop-everything events — vehicle health faults, tampering, charging faults. Keep this on.
telegram.connectivity_updates_desc: Notify when the daemon starts, stops, or restarts. Useful for diagnostics; chatty in normal use.
telegram.motion_text_desc: Send a motion alert (text, plus the snapshot photo when one is available) when surveillance detects motion. Video clips have their own toggle below.
telegram.auto_start_acc_off_desc: Launch the Telegram bot daemon automatically when the vehicle goes to ACC OFF, so commands work while parked. The daemon stops when the vehicle starts up.
telegram.daemon_start_pointer: Manual start / stop of the daemon lives on the Daemons page in the native app.
telegram.delivery_pointer: Delivery preferences (which events reach the chat) live on the Notifications → Telegram tab.
telegram.tyre_alerts_desc: Send a Telegram message when a tyre goes outside your configured pressure range, or when the TPMS reports a leak. Uses the limits set under Tyre pressure limits.
telegram.always_on_note: The daemon is enabled on the native Daemons screen, so it keeps running whether or not this toggle is on — including while parked. Turn it off there to stop it.

dashboard.heading: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Vehicle status, position and main controls.

oem_dashcam.title: OEM Dashcam
oem_dashcam.id_unset_desc: Open Diagnostics → Camera Probe to pick which AVMCamera id is the forward dashcam sensor. Auto = pano XOR 1; on Seal/Han pano is id 1 so OEM dashcam defaults to id 0.
oem_dashcam.enable_hint: Records the forward sensor to dvr_*.mp4. Picks up Quality / Codec / FPS from the Quality tab.
oem_dashcam.telemetry_overlay_desc: Stamps speed, GPS, and timestamp into dvr_*.mp4. Independent of the pano overlay setting.
oem_dashcam.telemetry_fields_desc: Choose what the overlay draws on OEM dashcam clips.
oem_dashcam.acc_off_hint: Off: stop recording at ACC off. 24/7: keep recording while parked (uses peripheral keep-alive; small drain on the 12V).
oem_dashcam.status_hint: Settings save now; recording starts once the daemon-side wiring lands.
oem_dashcam.status_hint_off: Pick Continuous or Smart above to enable the OEM forward-sensor recording.
oem_dashcam.status_hint_continuous_recording: Always recording. dvr_*.mp4 segments rotate every few minutes; pano dashcam keeps writing cam_*.mp4 in parallel.
oem_dashcam.status_hint_smart_recording: Mirroring pano dashcam. dvr_*.mp4 starts when pano starts (Continuous / Drive Mode / Proximity Guard fires) and stops with pano.
oem_dashcam.status_hint_continuous_surveillance: Always recording while parked, regardless of motion. Will use the most storage; useful for high-risk parking.
oem_dashcam.status_hint_smart_surveillance: Mirroring pano sentry. dvr_*.mp4 starts when motion + AI confirm a person/vehicle, alongside the pano event_*.mp4. Honors the same Safe Locations and Schedule.
oem_dashcam.recording_mode_desc: Controls when the forward dashcam sensor writes dvr_*.mp4 alongside the pano cam_*.mp4 dashcam clips.
oem_dashcam.surveillance_mode_desc: Controls when the forward dashcam sensor writes dvr_*.mp4 in response to surveillance (parked-car motion / sentry).
oem_dashcam.mode_off_desc_recording: Don't record from the OEM forward sensor. Pano dashcam keeps writing cam_*.mp4 normally.
oem_dashcam.mode_continuous_desc_recording: Always record dvr_*.mp4 while OverDrive is running, regardless of what the pano dashcam is doing.
oem_dashcam.mode_smart_desc_recording: Mirror the pano dashcam: when pano is recording (Drive Mode / Continuous / Proximity Guard fires), record dvr_*.mp4 too. Pano stops, OEM stops.
oem_dashcam.mode_off_desc_surveillance: Don't record from the OEM forward sensor on surveillance. Pano sentry keeps writing event_*.mp4 normally.
oem_dashcam.mode_continuous_desc_surveillance: Always record dvr_*.mp4 the whole time the car is parked, regardless of motion. Will burn through storage fastest.
oem_dashcam.mode_smart_desc_surveillance: Mirror pano motion detection: when surveillance fires (motion + AI confirms a person/vehicle), write dvr_*.mp4 alongside event_*.mp4. Honors the same Safe Locations, Schedule, and per-camera filters as the pano sentry.
oem_dashcam.surveillance_mode_set_smart: OEM Dashcam on surveillance: Smart (mirror pano motion)
oem_dashcam.native_dvr_explainer: The factory dashcam app records to /sdcard/DCIM/BYDCam and opens AVMCamera on every ACC ON. Disabling lets OverDrive own the camera without contention.
oem_dashcam.native_dvr_disable_toast: Native DVR disabled. OverDrive now owns the camera.
oem_dashcam.start_timeout: Pipeline start timed out — check daemon logs

notiflog.range_pick: Pick a start or end date
notiflog.delete_body: This removes it from the log. It cannot be undone.
notiflog.bulk_confirm_body: Delete {n} selected notifications? This cannot be undone.
notiflog.clear_body: This permanently deletes the entire notification log.
notiflog.empty_hint: Alerts you receive appear here so you can review them any time.

seatpos.gate_acc_off: The car is off, so the seat motors have no power. Applying or saving a position would be accepted and do nothing. Turn the car on to continue.
seatpos.gate_moving: The car is not in Park. Seat positions can only be applied with the gear in P — the vehicle refuses otherwise, even standing still with the brake pressed. Saving and renaming still work.
seatpos.empty: No saved positions yet. Adjust the seat and mirrors with the controls in the car, then press Save as new.
seatpos.used_by_body: These automations apply this position. They are edited on the Automations page.
seatpos.use_body: Opens the Automations page, where you can add a rule with the Apply Saved Seat Position action and pick {0}.
seatpos.save_new_body: Stores the seat and mirror geometry the car is in right now.
seatpos.overwrite_body: The current seat and mirror geometry replaces what is stored under this name. This cannot be undone.
seatpos.overwrite_used: These automations will start applying the new geometry.
seatpos.alias_body: The car keeps calling it {0}. This name is only used in OverDrive.
seatpos.parts_all_hint: Seat, mirrors and the interior lighting
seatpos.parts_geometry_hint: The position the car is in right now
seatpos.parts_ambient_hint: Colour, brightness and the light modes
seatpos.colour_body: Sets the colour stored on this position. The car is not changed until the position is applied.
seatpos.unconfirmed_note: These addresses are confirmed on a BYD Seal. Reading and saving positions is safe on any model — capture one, move the seat, capture another, and see whether the values follow. Applying asks first.
seatpos.unconfirmed_note_unset: No vehicle model is selected in Settings, so this car is treated as unknown. Reading and saving positions is safe — capture one, move the seat, capture another, and see whether the values follow. Applying asks first.
seatpos.unconfirmed_body: Seat and mirror positions are read using addresses confirmed on a BYD Seal, and your car may use different ones. Every value being sent was read back from this same car when the position was captured, and the car must be parked, so the likely worst case is that something other than the seat moves slightly. Worth checking the numbers first: capture a position, move the seat, capture another, and see whether the values follow the seat.

keymap.enable_desc: Master switch. When off, all hardware buttons behave exactly as stock — no key is intercepted.
keymap.allow_advanced_desc: Allow bindings that run a raw shell command. Leave off unless you know exactly what you're sending.
keymap.double_tap_window_desc: How long to wait for a second tap before a double-tap binding gives up and the single-tap fires. Raise it if your double-taps often trigger the single action; lower it if a single tap feels laggy.
keymap.a11y_needed: Key mapping needs the OverDrive accessibility service turned on to intercept hardware buttons. Bindings are saved but won't fire until you enable it.
keymap.a11y_pending: The service is enabled and starting up — hardware buttons become active in a few seconds. No action needed.
keymap.a11y_hint: Find OverDrive in the accessibility list and turn it on.
keymap.capture_hint: Tap “Capture”, then press the steering-wheel or dash button you want to rebind. Some buttons are handled by the car's firmware and never reach here — if nothing appears, that key can't be remapped.
keymap.manual_keycode_help: Android KeyEvent code, e.g. 87 = next track, 88 = previous.
keymap.block_native_single_desc: Stop the button's normal single-click from firing before your double-click action. A single tap still works, just after a short delay.
keymap.native_side_effect_warn: The car handles this button's built-in function (mute / Bluetooth) itself, so it may still fire alongside your mapped action — an app can't fully block it. Tip: a double-press binding with “Block single-click action” suppresses it best.
keymap.split_screen_desc: Open the app docked to one half of the screen instead of full-screen.
keymap.shell_warn: Runs as the daemon on every press. A bad command can disrupt the head unit. Requires “Advanced actions” enabled.
keymap.need_keycode: Capture or enter a keycode first.
keymap.advanced_disabled: Turn on “Advanced actions” to use this.
keymap.load_failed: Could not load key mapping settings.
keymap.empty_hint: Press a hardware button to capture it, then choose what it should do.
keymap.clip_window_hint: The complete clip can be up to 60 seconds.
keymap.clip_window_invalid: Choose a whole-second clip window from 1 to 60 seconds.
keymap.clip_sequence_unsupported: Instant replay must be bound directly to a key, not added to a sequence.
keymap.clip_restart_required: Instant replay is saved. The full window becomes available after a cold restart of Camera daemon from Daemons. The current dashcam recording was not interrupted.
keymap.editing: Editing binding — Save to update it
keymap.no_audio: No sounds — upload on the Automations page
keymap.no_automations: No automations — create one on the Automations page
keymap.need_value: Choose a value for this action.
keymap.sequence_hint: Add one action, or chain several with "Add step" to fire them all from one button.
keymap.qc_desc: Saves the action above as a button under Quick controls on the dashboard, with no physical key needed.
keymap.qc_title: Or add it as a dashboard button
keymap.need_action_group: Choose an action group to run.
keymap.no_action_groups: No action groups — create one on the Automations page
keymap.qc_confirm_delete: Delete this dashboard button? The action itself is not affected.
keymap.qc_need_action: Choose what the button should do.

network.warn_body: This head unit has one WiFi radio, so it cannot host a hotspot and stay on a WiFi network at the same time. While the hotspot is on, the car disconnects from WiFi and uses the built-in SIM's mobile data for itself and for every connected device. WiFi comes back when you turn the hotspot off.
network.enable_desc: Turns the head unit into a WiFi access point that shares the built-in SIM's internet.
network.credentials_note: The vehicle sets the hotspot name and password, so they can't be changed here. Tap either one to copy it.
network.limit_desc: When the hotspot has passed this much data it turns itself off and you get a notification. Leave empty for no limit. This is a total limit, not a speed limit.
network.keepalive_desc: If the access point drops on its own, start it again.
network.autostart: Start when the car powers on
network.autostart_desc: Turn the hotspot on once at each power-up.
network.proxy_system: Route this car's traffic through the proxy
network.proxy_system_desc: Sets the system-wide HTTP proxy so apps on the head unit use the encrypted tunnel. Needs the proxy service running.
network.proxy_clients_desc: Makes the proxy reachable from the hotspot. Each device must set that proxy itself in its own WiFi settings — connecting alone does not route its traffic.
network.proxy_clients_desc_fmt: Connecting to the hotspot is not enough — this vehicle can't route devices to the internet on its own, so each device must be pointed at the car's proxy. On the device, after joining this hotspot: 1) open its Wi-Fi settings and edit this network, 2) set Proxy to Manual, 3) Hostname {gw}, Port {port}, 4) save, then browse. The device keeps showing "no internet" and its own mobile-data icon even when this is working — that check ignores proxies.
network.limit_invalid: Enter a whole number of megabytes.
network.client_tunnel_desc_fmt: Sends connected devices' traffic through the encrypted tunnel before it leaves the car's SIM. Point devices at port {tp} instead of {rp}. Slower, since it adds a hop. Turning this off stops that port listening immediately.

genai.empty_desc: Text is the default. Vehicle data is attached only when you choose a grounded action or explicitly ask for it.
genai.enable_desc: Master kill switch. Off cancels active requests and releases the provider transport.
genai.base_url_hint: HTTPS is recommended. HTTP is accepted for a trusted local compatible endpoint.
genai.realtime_hint: Used only for provider-native realtime audio. It is never routed through a speech-to-text fallback.

storage.budget_over_capacity: Your storage limits add up to {total} on {volume}, which only holds {capacity}. Lower a limit, or the oldest clips across {others} may be deleted sooner than your limits promise.
storage.budget_over_capacity_solo: Your storage limit of {total} is larger than {volume}, which only holds {capacity}. The oldest clips will be deleted sooner than your limit promises.
storage.budget_over_free: Your storage limits add up to {total} on {volume}, but only {capacity} is available there. Lower a limit or free up space, or the oldest clips across {others} may be deleted sooner than your limits promise.
storage.budget_over_free_solo: Your storage limit of {total} exceeds the {capacity} available on {volume}. Lower the limit or free up space, or the oldest clips will be deleted sooner than your limit promises.
